title: Frog Laughing
blurb: Wheezy, squeaky, and uncannily like your weirdest friend losing composure at two in the morning. The laughing frog became a beloved reaction sound because it is reliably funnier than whatever it is responding to, and that is rare in a reaction clip. Use it when something is stupid-funny rather than clever-funny. The frog is a specialist in the former and has no interest at all in wit. Hearing this without smiling is close to impossible, and most laughs cannot claim as much.
origin: A viral clip of a frog making a laugh-like squeak.
